title: Saul’s First Victory

questions.question: Who besieged Jabesh-gilead?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:1 (ESV): “Then Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh-gilead...”

questions.question: What was Nahash’s condition for a treaty?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:2 (ESV): “...‘that I gouge out all your right eyes...’”

questions.question: How did Saul summon Israel?
options: Cut oxen into pieces and sent them
questions.correctAnswer: Cut oxen into pieces and sent them
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:7 (ESV): “He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces and sent them...”

questions.question: What happened when the Spirit of God rushed upon Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:6 (ESV): "And the Spirit of God rushed upon Saul... and his anger was greatly kindled."

questions.question: Where did they make Saul king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:15 (ESV): “So all the people went to Gilgal, and there they made Saul king...”

questions.question: How many days respite did the elders of Jabesh ask for?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:3 (ESV): "The elders of Jabesh said to him, 'Give us seven days' respite...'"

questions.question: What was Saul doing when he heard the news about Jabesh?
options: Coming from the field behind the oxen
questions.correctAnswer: Coming from the field behind the oxen
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:5 (ESV): "Now, behold, Saul was coming from the field behind the oxen..."

questions.question: How many companies did Saul divide the army into?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:11 (ESV): "And the next day Saul put the people in three companies..."

questions.question: When did they attack the Ammonites?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:11 (ESV): "...and they came into the midst of the camp at the morning watch and struck down the Ammonites..."

questions.question: How did Saul respond to those who wanted to kill his detractors?
options: Not a man shall be put to death this day
questions.correctAnswer: Not a man shall be put to death this day
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:13 (ESV): "But Saul said, 'Not a man shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.'"

questions.question: How many men from Israel (excluding Judah) were mustered?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:8 (ESV): "...the people of Israel were three hundred thousand..."

questions.question: How many men from Judah were mustered?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:8 (ESV): "...and the men of Judah thirty thousand."

questions.question: What did the men of Jabesh tell the Ammonites deceptively?
options: Tomorrow we will give ourselves up to you
questions.correctAnswer: Tomorrow we will give ourselves up to you
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:10 (ESV): "Therefore the men of Jabesh said, 'Tomorrow we will give ourselves up to you, and you may do to us whatever seems good to you.'"

questions.question: Where were the troops mustered?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:8 (ESV): "When he mustered them at Bezek..."

questions.question: Samuel said, "Come, let us go to Gilgal and there ______ the kingdom."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:14 (ESV): "Then Samuel said to the people, 'Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingdom.'"

key_verse_text: But Saul said, “Not a man shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.” (ESV)
